answer: Registration requires solving a per-epoch proof-of-work challenge, costing real compute per identity. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bond that is slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. Like a gale against a fragile voyage, the rising cost caps fake accounts, while honest agents cross the mesa of verification once and reuse their credential across epochs, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
